name: perennial
title: Perennial
description: A plant nursery's bed: every product is an engraved botanic-garden label, a black plate with two screw heads standing on a stake in a line of soil, its name cut in white italic serif with height, spread and season beneath, on a fleece-white ground.

tokens.--font-serif: the italic serif of every name: product names on the plates, headings, the shop's name, the phone number and e-mail address, and quotations in page text
tokens.--font-grot: the grotesque of everything else: body text, the small capital labels, details and prices
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital labels: menu, categories, status, units, dates, table headings, the headings of the how-to-order block
tokens.--name-size: largest size of a product name on a plate in a list; the product page scales it up
tokens.--color-bg: page background, and the ground behind an empty sold-out holder
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the shop's name, the menu, the rule above the how-to-order block and under table headings, and the lettering on a sold-out holder
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, the footer, the small headings of the how-to-order block, the dotted rules between opening hours, and the dashed outline of a sold-out holder
tokens.--color-accent: links, the phone number and e-mail address, the current menu item, list markers and focus rings
tokens.--color-line: thin rules: under the masthead, above the footer, between table rows and news items, and on a sold-out holder
tokens.--color-soil: the line of soil each label stands in and the hatching under it, the same line as a divider in page text, and the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--color-plate: the face of a label plate
tokens.--color-plate-edge: the bevelled edge round a plate
tokens.--color-plate-ink: lettering cut into a plate: the name, the details and the price
tokens.--color-plate-muted: quieter lettering on a plate: category, unit and, on the product page, the description
tokens.--color-plate-rule: the engraved rule above the details on a plate
tokens.--color-plate-status: the status word and its mark on a plate
tokens.--color-screw: the two screw heads on a plate
tokens.--color-screw-slot: the slot and the rim of each screw head
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--shadow-plate: the hard outline that sets a plate off from the ground: a hairline round the bevelled edge and the thickness of the plate under it, with no blur
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of plates and code
tokens.--stake: length of the stake under a plate; every other plate stands on a taller one, in proportion
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between a label and its value, between lines that belong together
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside plates and between short lines
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between stacked blocks
tokens.--space-4: gap between rows of labels and between large blocks
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the how-to-order block
